turns.text: That is our firewood pile. I cover it with a tarp every night, but it sits right against the wall.
The brush is what I cut last weekend. I have not hauled it away yet, it is still green.
This fence is old cedar. It was here when we bought the place.

findings.instruction: Move the firewood at least 30 feet from the house or fully cover it with fire-resistant material.
findings.reason: The uncovered wood pile sits directly against the house wall in the frames.

findings.instruction: Replace the wooden fence next to the house with fire-resistant material.
findings.reason: The old cedar fence stands within a few feet of the house in the frames.

findings.instruction: Remove the cut brush pile from near the house and haul it away.
findings.reason: The cut brush pile lies on the ground within 30 feet of the house in the frames.
